transport: PostgreSQL functions returning jsonb; authenticated carr_writer connection only

digest.meaning: lowercase SHA-256 hex of an adapter-generated cryptographically random 256-bit token

rules: Uses the existing bcrypt(SHA-256(password)) verifier and the existing shared five-failures-per-fifteen-minutes allowance.
The fifth failed password returns locked. Correct passwords cannot bypass the window. A correct password before lockout resets failures.
A retained digest retries with the same expiry after password verification; revoked or expired rows refuse. Replay never extends expiry.
A digest already bound to another slug refuses even with that other slug's valid password.
At most ten unexpired rows per slug, including revoked rows. Capacity returns denied without evicting browsers.
A successful new exchange removes expired rows for its slug. A permanent digest-only ownership tombstone prevents reissuance after expiry cleanup. Never reuse a digest for a new login.

read.requires_transaction_mode: read-write transaction because authorization takes a row lock
rules: Always checks live slug, digest, expiry, revocation, portal enablement and canonical client binding. No stale cache. Changing the portal password hash atomically revokes every existing session for that portal; revoked digests cannot be reused.
No client, deal or material selectors. No internal notes. Refuses libraries above the canonical 100-material cap.
Repeated revocation of a retained row succeeds without changing its first revocation timestamp.
Unknown or cross-slug digest refuses. Revocation also works for disabled portals.

errors.portal_access_denied: Invalid input, credentials, binding, capacity or unavailable projection; return no content.
errors.database_unavailable: Adapter-owned transport error. SQL errors propagate. Refuse access and return no content; never serve a cached success.

adapter_requirements: Commit denial results so shared lockout counters persist. Do not throw and roll back on denied or locked.
Generate tokens and SHA-256 digests outside Postgres. Store only digest in Postgres. Do not log passwords or tokens.
Keep existing slug URL and password. Set a separate __Host-portal-<slug> cookie, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no longer than expires_at.
Parameterize SQL. Never accept caller-provided client/deal selectors or choose a slug from token content.
Use finite database timeouts, bounded connection concurrency, no automatic password retry loop, and alert on database errors.
All content, packages and files must pass this slug's live session check. Public HTTP wiring and production proof belong to unit B and host wiring.
